P1 — Label-dependent weights invalidate unconditional exchangeable coverage — Counterevidence: Prior fixed-weight conformal result is valid with its assumptions. Training can be fixed while calibration-label weights remain random. This example is not a claim about an actual trained CUPS checkpoint.

P2 — Rank-weight changepoint bound needs time ordering — Counterevidence: The bound works for actual recency weights with the specified post-change swap assumptions. No alignment between feature rank and time is imposed in CUPS.

P3 — Beta total-variation bound false near boundary — Counterevidence: Exact Beta Hellinger affinity Eq22 is valid. Ambiguous vector notation cannot restore the false scalar bound; actual benchmark numbers are not refuted.

proposition.claim:
Weighted score quantile has coverage at least 1-alpha minus unconditional swap total variation terms for the proposed feature weights.

Feature ranks wprime_i=rho^(n+1-rank(w_i)) imply weighted swap TV at most rho^k after a changepoint.

Beta(a1,n-a1) and Beta(a2,n-a2) with abs(a1-a2)<=k have pairwise TV bounded by sqrt(2-2*(1-2k/(n+k))^(k/2)).

n4 k3 rho.5, old observation rank4, recent ranks1,2,3; old score .2 and recent/test .8; recent full observations iid and feature weights below old; TV(old swap)=1 and recent swaps0.

repair.content:
Prespecify calibration weights and include the test infinity atom, or establish a bound involving distances conditional on weights; current unconditional bound is not sufficient.

With wprime_i=rho^(n+1-i), old mass=rho^k(1-rho^(n-k))/(1-rho^n)<=rho^k. This alone does not repair label-dependent coverage.

Use min(1,sqrt(2-2*B((a1+a2)/2,n-(a1+a2)/2)/sqrt(B(a1,n-a1)*B(a2,n-a2)))); no k-only corrected guarantee certified.
